description: This file defines the AdvancedValueBinder class, which extends DefaultValueBinder and implements custom logic for binding various data types to spreadsheet cells in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for handling strings, fractions, percentages, currency, times, and date/time values, as well as style formatting.

classes.name: AdvancedValueBinder
classes.description: A class that extends DefaultValueBinder to provide advanced data binding and formatting capabilities for cells in PhpSpreadsheet, with support for various data types and custom styles.

methods.name: bindValue
methods.description: Binds a value to a cell, handling different data types and formatting appropriately, including strings, booleans, fractions, percentages, currency, times, and date/time values.

methods.name: setImproperFraction
methods.description: Converts a string representing an improper fraction into a numeric value and applies a specific number format to the cell.

methods.name: setProperFraction
methods.description: Converts a string representing a proper fraction into a numeric value and applies a specific number format to the cell.

methods.name: setPercentage
methods.description: Converts a string with a percentage sign into a decimal value and applies percentage formatting.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets a numeric value with a currency format, incorporating the currency code.

methods.name: setTimeHoursMinutes
methods.description: Converts a 'HH:MM' string into a numeric representation of time and applies time formatting.

methods.name: setTimeHoursMinutesSeconds
methods.description: Converts a 'HH:MM:SS' string into a numeric representation of time and applies time formatting.
